item.title: Arts school linked to Epstein reveals decades of abuse in new report
item.description: A report details around 70 allegations of sexual abuse by nearly 50 adults at Interlochen, with former students speaking out.

item.title: Women voters may decide tight Maine Senate race
item.description: The contest between Susan Collins and Troy Jackson is a key Senate battle, with both candidates seeking women's support to win.

item.title: Who actually needs testosterone therapy?
item.description: The military is set to screen troops for low testosterone, while social media is full of claims about the therapy. But who truly requires it?

item.title: Voters weary of two-party system, new poll indicates openness to major reforms
item.description: A recent poll finds support for shifting the U.S. to proportional representation, which would elect multiple lawmakers per district.
